about.title: Words for everyone.
about.story: LEXICADE is an original word arcade. No ads, no marketing trackers and no mandatory signup.
about.privacy: As a guest, progress stays in this browser. With an account, email, public username, preferences and rounds are processed by Supabase for authentication, progress and leaderboards. Public username, avatar, optional country and level may appear on profiles and leaderboards. We do not sell your data. Export and delete data in Settings. Technical logs and authentication messages follow the service infrastructure. Final retention, controller contact and legal bases must be defined before launch.
about.terms: Use an appropriate public username, respect other players and do not manipulate results. Coins are virtual, have no monetary value and cannot be bought with money. Accounts require a minimum age of 13; ages 13–17 require a guardian-permission declaration. Guests can play without an account. Mechanics inspired by classic games use original or licensed art and content. The service may be updated and invalid results removed. The minors' consent flow requires legal review before public use.
